svg.title: Motion and feedback — Truecolor / Ocean
svg.desc: Spinners, notifications and calm transitions. Actual ratatui buffer renders: toasts, toasts-stacked, toasts-fading, spinner, verification-pending, verification-earned, verification-modes, motion-modes, motion-working, motion-started, motion-mid-flight, motion-settled, motion-reduced
